note: Set A provides more specific and useful engineering claims, particularly binding section sizes (e.g., HSS4X6X1/4, L4X4X5/16) to their correct elevation views (C1, A1), whereas Set B is often generic ('Structural Member'). However, Set A contains condition errors (attributing 2'-0" to C1 instead of C3, and referencing 'Grid C1'). Set B has significant interpretation errors (claiming 9'-0" is Grade to T.O. Steel instead of First Floor to T.O. Steel) and extraction inaccuracies (value '27 ft' vs quote '27'-8"'). Set A is preferred for higher fidelity on member sections despite similar error counts.
